newsitem.title: USA: Coke's multiple seen as extravagant - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Coke's multiple seen as extravagant - Barron's.

text.p: The multiple of about twice its growth rate that Coca Cola Co has gained is "extravagant," according to a columnist for the weekly financial tabloid, Barron's.
"We somehow find the multiple awarded Coke, of roughly twice its growth rate, extravagant," said Alan Abelson in his column "Up & Down Wall Street" published in the tabloid's March 3 edition.

"The stock over the past year has gone from under 40 to above 63 and closed Friday at 61. It thus is selling at 40 times the latest 12-month earnings and around 37 time this year's estimate, both historic highs," he said.

"Nowhere is it written...that Coke will continue to grow even at 18 percent a year appreciably into the future," he said. "Tastes change, competition occasionally rears its ugly head, some institution might sell a share."
